name: Bellaguna Golf Residences Hibiscus
shortDescription: Hibiscus is a low-rise condominium within Laguna Phuket, overlooking the Laguna Golf Phuket course near Bang Tao Beach.
description: Hibiscus is a low-rise condominium within Laguna Phuket, overlooking the Laguna Golf Phuket course near Bang Tao Beach. It forms part of Bellaguna Golf Residences, which comprises five interconnected finger-shaped low-rise buildings. Layouts range from one to three bedrooms plus two- and three-bedroom penthouses, with four shared pools. Select ground-floor residences have private pools or gardens.
facilities: Four free-form swimming pools with terraces
Select ground-floor units with private pool or garden
Community: Laguna Golf Phuket membership (Laguna Advantage)

researchNotes: Relationship: Bellaguna is Banyan Group's residential brand launched January 2026; 'Bellaguna Golf Residences' is the golf-course residence collection (five finger-shaped buildings); Hibiscus appears to be the name of this release/building group within it, though the developer page never defines 'Hibiscus' explicitly (inference). Developer page gives no price, size, floors, unit count or completion. Size max 297 sqm and ~100 units come from search-snippet portal text, unverified. Floors, unit total, parking, fees not found. Area given as both Bang Tao and Choeng Thale (same locality, Laguna). | One page shows from 13,200,000 (1BR 67 sqm) to 19,190,000 (2BR 100 sqm). Search-snippet portal listings show other figures (about 10.56M and 11.81M for 1BR; 17.89M for 2BR) that were not verified; 10,560,000 appears on the source page as an instalment figure, i.e. 80% of 13.2M. | Phase 4 (2026-11-19) a property portal fields filled where empty: totalUnits, floors, completionDate. a property portal is a portal; values not confirmed by the developer. Property portal audit 2026-11-21: starting price, units advertised, completion, floors/buildings and unit table taken from the portal project and listing pages (unit table replaced). Nearby places refreshed 2026-11-23: beaches, hospitals, big stores (Tesco Lotus, Big C, Makro), markets, schools and kindergartens added from OpenStreetMap as straight-line distances from the FazWaz project coordinates (not road distance). Where a category already had a distance from the developer or a portal, it was kept and not replaced.
